player_baselines.method: The player's own games in the window (recency-weighted mean; percentiles of his game log), scaled by half of the opponent's allowed-per-game deviation from league average for that position, capped at +/-15%. This is NOT the three-model consensus and has not been validated against prices. Injury replacements, role changes and game script are not applied: the analyst must adjust for them.

team_projection.note: Bootstrap of each team's real quarter scores. 'matchup_pair' includes the opponent's defence; 'independent' is the legacy sampler. No injuries, no weather, no fitted calibration. On 2026 weeks 1-8 neither sampler beat the market; treat probabilities near the market number as no information.

phase_ledger.detail: Per-defender targets/yards allowed (PFR) and explosive plays allowed. Who covers whom is NOT known.

phase_ledger.name: QB pressure, blitz, scramble
phase_ledger.detail: Sack rate, sacks + QB hits rate (a floor on pressure), blitz rate, scrambles.

phase_ledger.name: Offensive line, pass rush, coaching
phase_ledger.detail: Depth-chart line, pressure allowed, run yards by direction, pass-rush leaders. No line grades.

phase_ledger.name: Injury and depth chart
phase_ledger.detail: Official weekly report and depth chart; ESPN live list when reachable. Recent roster arrivals/departures.

phase_ledger.name: Weather, roof, travel
phase_ledger.detail: Roof, surface, rest days, site; National Weather Service kickoff forecast: OK.

phase_ledger.name: Timestamped book prices
